name: Somalia

elections.type: Presidential and House of the People
elections.note: Shift from clan-based indirect voting to direct elections is disputed.

summary: The federal government's 2024 constitutional amendments replace clan-based indirect elections with universal suffrage, but opposition groups and the Puntland and Jubaland states reject them. The opposition argues the president's term ended on 15 May 2026.

parties.name: Federal Government / JSP
policies: Says its mandate runs to May 2027

parties.name: Somali Future Council
policies: Says the president's term expired in May 2026
Proposes the Speaker as acting president

parties.name: Puntland and Jubaland
policies: Withdrew recognition of or cooperation with the federal government
Demand a constitution approved by referendum
